# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-055#gherkin-support

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision.** SEED-055#gherkin-support (`.planning/seeds/SEED-055-gherkin-support.md#gherkin-support`), plan `.planning/slice-plans/033-gherkin-line-counts/PLAN.md` (all slices done), revision `9fb9648da2cc06c0bb9dfe0fee8da8491f4fe93a`. Isolated detached scratch worktree at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-055-gherkin-support-scratch` (clean pre-probe state; execution checkout unused for edits). Scratch removed after restoration.
- **Promise.** Key example 1: a Feature with Background (header+one step), Scenario (header+two steps), and Scenario Outline (header+two steps+Examples header+table header+two data rows) yields three functions with NLOC `2`, `3`, and `7`, each CCN `1`; directory CSV analysis and `-l gherkin` expose the same three functions.
- **Fault.** In `lizard_languages/gherkin.py` `_handle_line`, for an in-outline `Examples:`/`Scenarios:` line, replaced `return self._emit_held() + (line,)` with `return self._finish_before_structure() + (line,)` so the outline ends before its Examples table and those rows leave Outline NLOC. Fixture and assertions stayed intact; only Examples ownership changed.
- **Fixture.** Inline `SEED_EXAMPLE_1` in `test/test_languages/testGherkin.py`, reused by `test/testGherkinCLI.py::test_directory_csv_and_language_filter` (temporary directory with `basket.feature` plus a non-Gherkin file).
- **Intended assertion.** `TestGherkinSeedExample1.test_written_blocks_have_expected_nloc_ccn_and_ranges` equality on `(name, nloc, ccn, start_line, end_line)` including Outline NLOC `7` and end line `15` (`test/test_languages/testGherkin.py:41`). CLI companion checks that filtered CSV rows include a line starting with `7,` and that `analyze_file` returns NLOC `[2, 3, 7]`.
- **Runs.** Focused command: `nix develop -c python -m pytest test/test_languages/testGherkin.py::TestGherkinSeedExample1::test_written_blocks_have_expected_nloc_ccn_and_ranges test/testGherkinCLI.py::TestGherkinCLI::test_directory_csv_and_language_filter -v`.
  - Baseline (pre-fault): `2 passed in 0.23s`; `/usr/bin/time -p` real **18.82 s** (includes first Nix/venv setup in the scratch tree). Pre-probe HEAD `9fb9648da2cc06c0bb9dfe0fee8da8491f4fe93a`, empty `git status --porcelain`, `lizard_languages/gherkin.py` SHA-256 `0fa69de54cfb268fb68f9c4ffa2aa08713d8e71e395b68e3a431930214e19208`.
  - Fault: independent probe of `SEED_EXAMPLE_1` returned Outline NLOC `3` and end line `11` (was `7`/`15`) — wrong behavior on the Examples-ownership path. Focused run: `2 failed`; seed assertion failed expecting `('Scenario Outline: second', 7, 1, 9, 15)` got `('Scenario Outline: second', 3, 1, 9, 11)`; CLI failed on missing `7,` CSV prefix. Runner `2 failed in 0.15s`; real **0.60 s**.
  - Restored: file bytes and SHA-256 `0fa69de54cfb268fb68f9c4ffa2aa08713d8e71e395b68e3a431930214e19208` matched the recorded original; fault marker absent; `git status --porcelain` empty and HEAD `9fb9648da2cc06c0bb9dfe0fee8da8491f4fe93a` matched pre-probe; same focused command `2 passed in 0.12s`, real **0.50 s**. Scratch worktree then removed.
- **Finding.** **Caught.** Ending a Scenario Outline before its Examples table drops Outline NLOC from `7` to `3` on key example 1, and the maintained seed-example assertion fails on the intended NLOC/range equality; the CSV/`-l gherkin` companion also fails on the missing `7,` row.

## Costs

- **Test runtime.** Measured with `/usr/bin/time -p` real on the focused command: baseline 18.82 s; fault 0.60 s; restored 0.50 s. Pytest also reported baseline 0.23 s, fault 0.15 s, restored 0.12 s (runner session time, excluding Nix shell overhead on later runs).
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separately supported human-effort measure was recorded for this invocation.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separately supported agent-effort (token or similar) measure was recorded for this invocation.
- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 118892 ms (measured), from 1794360617478 to 1794360736370 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
